answer: Anchor every identity to a beacon of verifiable work: each agent emits a periodic proof whose hash chain forms an unforgeable ledger of effort. The beacon signal is validated by an opal-weighted quorum where stake is non-transferable and decays without fresh proof, so a sybil farm cannot recycle history. A coordinated fleet of fakes collapses into an island of correlated signals — the quorum detects the clustering and slashes the entire cluster in one epoch. The attacker pays per-head beacon costs that compound with fleet size, while honest agents pay near-zero marginal cost.
